column1: Integrated genomic and proteomic analyses identify stimulus-dependent molecular changes associated with distinct modes of skeletal muscle atrophy
RNA sequencing datasets and analysis . Values expressed represent the transcripts per kilobase million (TPM).

"-log10(P)" and "log2(FC)" represent the log transformed variables used for volcano plots. P is the adjusted P value, and FC is the fold change in levels compared to control. "SIG" indicates where P<0.05
"CYR61" Contains the dataset comparing RNA sequencing from 30 month old mice electroporated with control siRNA (siNT) vs Cyr61 siRNA (siCYR) TA muscles (n=3)
